title: Völundio ~Divergent Sword Saga~
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Cleo, a mercenary of ten years who dreams of buying a home and living peacefully, meets Kohaku, a mysterious demi-human girl who says she has foreseen his death and vows to protect him. On a battlefield where powerful 'different swords' fly about, the two start running a tavern where soldiers gather. From the creator of Helck.
life_message: A peaceful, stable life is worth fighting to survive for, even in the middle of war.

content.note: War setting, mercenaries and bandits (Comikey and MangaDex descriptions; AniList War, Tragedy).
Foreseen death and tragedy (Comikey description; AniList Tragedy spoiler tag).

Tavern setting (MangaDex description; MU Bar/s, Bartender/s).
Running a tavern as a business.

dominant: Pragmatism (survive and settle down), Communitarianism (tavern community), Might makes right (critiqued)
